title: Service Contracts: term extension limits by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference sets out the three term extension figures of each Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts tier: the longest single extension, how many calendar days before expiry an extension may first be requested, and how many extensions one contract may take.

## Parameters by tier
| Tier | Longest single extension (calendar days) | Extension may be requested from (calendar days before expiry) | Extensions per contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 30 | 30 | 1 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 30 | 30 | 1 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 60 | 45 | 1 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 90 | 60 | 2 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 90 | 60 | 2 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 120 | 90 | 3 |

## Upper bound on total extension (derived)
Because each extension moves the expiry date by no more than the tier's longest single extension, and a contract takes no more than the tier's number of extensions, the expiry date can move in total by at most the longest single extension multiplied by the number of extensions allowed:

| Tier | Total extension, at most (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 30 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 30 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 60 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 180 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 180 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 360 |

## Quick questions
**An AHL Key Account Contract has already been extended once. Can it take another extension?** The tier allows 2 extensions per contract, so one more remains available under this figure.

**How many days before expiry may the customer of an AHL Regional Account Contract first ask for an extension?** From 45 calendar days before the contract expires.
